basis: Each company's latest full fiscal year, in $ million. Revenue, EBITDA margin (operating profit before depreciation as a share of revenue) and net margin (net profit as a share of revenue) are that year's; return on capital employed (ROCE) is the latest reported. Consolidated accounts where the company files them. Banks and lenders have no EBITDA margin or ROCE.
